title: A review that passed on a head carries to a head that differs only by the merge tool's own records-page and record-claim commits
why: Ask of runner 12 via the coordinator (06:46 CST Nov 14, relayed; runner 12's own numbers, one sample, the coordinator read no runs): q_max #1174 (merged 06:42 CST) needed three recorded heads: 7b69870d (rounds 1, 2 FAIL, 3 PASS), then the records-page commit 0a550055 and the record-claim commit f3ac50a6, each with its own sonnet fix check PASS. The records step and the claim step each push a commit, so a batch gets two extra fix checks and two extra CI runs (about 17 and 24 min each, n=1, unread by triage). Wanted: the merge tool carries the earlier review across the commits it writes itself, when the diff since the reviewed head is only those tool-written files. Kin, not the same: review-carries-by-tree (a re-cut PR with an equal tree), fix-check-records-carry (a fix-check FAIL on a records-only diff), records-page-before-ready and owner item 830 (open: whether a lane runs the records push before ready). A guard or check change if the tool starts to accept a diff unreviewed: round 3 applies; the diff must be only the tool's own records and claim files, which the tool can prove. Do not start before owner item 830 is answered: its answer decides whether the extra commits stay. UNBLOCKED READ 15:04 CST Nov 14 (item 830 answered c, not a; triage's reading, unchecked): the ready records push stays, so a review still meets a head that differs by the tool's own records commit. The step waited on item 830; it can start. Kin: step ci-scope-skips-records-only-push. LANE STARTED 15:11 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:09): lane session_013NEJL3kMXMjJ99c4cwtfXS; item 830 is answered, so it may start; item 840 stays open and the ready-push lane keeps holding. LANE QUESTION 15:12 CST Nov 14 (the lane session_013NEJL3kMXMjJ99c4cwtfXS): it asked whether the coordinator's start was a real grant to build and open one draft PR, since it came as a notification with no owner message. Triage pointed it at the standing grant "Lane draft PR" (owner 2026-11-12 17:19 CST, until withdrawn, in the claude-settings project CLAUDE.md): any lane a coordinator or another lane started may open its own draft PR and never marks it ready; the lane reads that text itself. The build is the brief's, set by the coordinator. KIN NOTE 15:26 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:23): its lane is stacked on #3388, which is on the rounds 1-3 route above. PATTERN 15:56 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:55, from runner 10's read of four rows: #3405, #3413, #3352, #3261; the coordinator read the compare for #3352 only; triage read none): `merge --ready` pushes a records page whenever the page differs, so each such PR's head moves one commit at `--ready`, stales its record, and costs one fresh fix verifier plus a record. Today: #3352 (073e75142023 to 755366799752) and #3261 (4543f1cdf11e to a8af633727f8), both docs/records.md only, one parent. Runner 10's cheaper fix: lanes run the page build before hand-in. Owner ruling own-830-c-ci-scope-green-before-head (page item 830 c, 15:02 CST Nov 14) chose to skip CI on a records-only push after a fully green head; it does not stop the head from moving or the record from staling. Open question the coordinator does not rule on: does c plus the lane-built page remove enough of this, or is option a of item 830 needed? Triage did not post it to the owner: the lane-built page is a lane habit that changes no tool verdict, and the owner has not been asked how it reads against c. It goes to the owner if the lane-built page fails to stop the head moving.
